settings.question: Can Ontario public-sector buyers purchase storage and filing through OECM?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits — can order through the OECM agreement without running an open tender. Send your requisition to quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com or call 1-800-835-9565 to set up an OECM purchase order.

settings.question: How do I choose between lateral and vertical filing cabinets?
settings.answer: Lateral cabinets store letter and legal files side-by-side and work well alongside open-plan workstations or as room dividers — the typical pick for contemporary offices and benching environments. Vertical cabinets store letter files front-to-back and have a smaller floor footprint, which suits narrow corridors and private offices. Call 1-800-835-9565 with your file volume and room dimensions and we'll recommend a configuration.

settings.question: Do your storage cabinets include locks?
settings.answer: Cylinder locks are typically included as standard on lateral and vertical filing cabinets, pedestals, and storage cabinets — though specifications vary by model and brand. For specific security or compliance requirements (fire-rated cabinets, controlled-records storage, master-key sets, etc.), call 1-800-835-9565 with the model and the requirement and we'll confirm options directly with the manufacturer.

settings.question: Can storage finishes be matched to our existing desks?
settings.answer: Yes. Most manufacturers we carry — Global Furniture Group, OTG, and Heartwood among them — offer coordinated finishes across their desk, storage, and table lines, so credenzas, pedestals, and bookcases can be specified in the same wood or laminate as the workstation surfaces. If you already own desks from any of these brands and need matching storage, send us a photo or the original PO and we'll quote the matching SKUs.

settings.hero_subtitle: Commercial filing and storage for Ontario institutions — lateral files, lockers, credenzas, and high-density systems.
settings.intro_text:
Storage and filing keep a commercial workplace organized and secure — lateral and vertical filing cabinets for active records, mobile pedestals at the desk, storage cabinets and bookcases for supplies, plus lockers, credenzas, and wardrobe units for shared spaces. Brant Business Interiors supplies commercial-grade storage and filing to school boards, hospitals, municipalities, and offices across Ontario, with delivery from Peterborough and on-site installation on volume orders.

Start with what you need to store: lateral filing cabinets and vertical filing cabinets for records, mobile pedestals for the desk, storage cabinets and bookcases & shelving for supplies, lockers and wardrobe & coat storage for shared areas, plus fireproof file cabinets and fireproof safes for protected records.

Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner — eligible Ontario public-sector buyers can order storage and filing through the OECM agreement without an open tender.
